report.summary: Ordered M10x30 steel 8.8 ISO 4017 hex bolts from Pacific Bolt Co (listing 55), shipping to US-MI. Asked for 260; billed for 275 because they come in packs of 25. Unit price 0.2082 USD. Landed total 79.09 USD: goods 57.25, freight 18.40, tax 3.44. Delivery 2026-11-10, before the 2026-11-20 deadline. This was the lowest landed cost among the listings that could fill the order. A counter at 0.19 was declined as below the seller's floor, so I re-quoted and accepted the list price. Within mandate. Order 1 status DELIVERED, tracking TRJ-00000001. The other quote thread (Atlantic Hardware, 83.28) was withdrawn.

Nothing was ordered: Trajano has no titanium Grade 5 M8 x 30 mm ISO 4017 hex bolts. A search with material "titanium" found nothing. A broader search for every M8 x 30 mm listing shipping to US-OH by 2026-11-20 (qty 500) found only steel (8.8, 10.9) and stainless (A2/A4) bolts. Following our instructions and the marketplace rules, I did not buy a substitute. No quotes were requested, no money was spent and the mandate was not used. We'll need another supplier for titanium Grade 5.

No order placed. Trajano does not carry titanium Grade 5 hex bolts. Search for M8 x 30 mm, titanium, ISO 4017, 500 pcs, ship to US-OH by 2026-11-20 returned no hits and no exclusions; a broader titanium search (any diameter/standard, lengths 0-130 mm) also returned nothing.
